answer: Entry fee per identity is k² tokens, where k counts identities already linked to the same funder, IP block or Jetty server host. One agent pays 1. A farm of 100 sybils pays 338,350 in total. Moving funds so that agents wander to fresh wallets triggers a 30-day stake lock before k resets. A dormant relic identity keeps its k, so old accounts give no discount.
